title: Turning tracking on marks the first bin as default when none is
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TRKON-NODEF-01) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A} and 5 in {Bin-B}, and neither bin is marked Default.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is on.
  3. Read the Inventory section.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Read the {Part-A} row in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The first bin row, {Bin-A}, now carries the Default pill and {Bin-B} does not. The quantities are unchanged: {Bin-A} 2 and {Bin-B} 5.
  • Step 4: The dialog closes with no bin error.
  • Step 5: Total Qty shows "7 Available" (2 + 5 = 7) and Bin Location / Quantity shows "{Bin-A} | 2" and "{Bin-B} | 5".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S5-R8, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.6 (Switch back on), 13 Oct copy. Set-up route: QA lead's answer of 9 Oct 2026, situation 2 (import with Grid Location empty gives a part with no default bin). Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R8: “In the part dialog, when the user turns tracking on and the part has bin locations but none is the default, the dialog marks the first one as the default.”
